lines.en: I’m a totally normal guy with totally normal hobbies and interests.

lines.en: : Hello, normal human [teenager]s.

lines.zh: : 我不喜欢你脸上带笑问我这种问题。而我知道你口袋里大概还揣着把刀，就更不喜欢了。

lines.en: : How else am I going to defend myself if I get attacked on the way home?

lines.zh: : 要我说，{i}所有{/i}[teenage]女孩都应该随身带刀。

lines.zh: : 你知道那会让已报案和{i}未{/i}报案的性侵数量发生多大的变化吗？

: Do you want to go hang out outside? The fire’s probably still going.
lines.zh: : 要不要去外面待会儿？火大概还没灭。

lines.zh: : 火？在居民区？

lines.zh: : 你现在是警察还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Residential areas are the best place to start fires.
lines.zh: : 居民区可是最适合放火的地方。

lines.zh: : 再说了，火被安全地困在垃圾桶里。而且要说有什么事我很有自信，那就是生火和维持火不灭。

lines.zh: : 我觉得那可不是什么值得自信的事。

lines.zh: : 好吧，我挺高兴你至少找到了{i}一{/i}件能让你投入热情的事。

lines.zh: : 我只想占用一秒钟提醒你们一下洗手间有多脏，顺便建议你们最好{i}别{/i}用那种眼神看 Sensei。

: Woah! It’s suddenly time for my break! Who could have foreseen such an inconvenient ceasefire to a conversation I was definitely prepared to have tonight?!
lines.zh: : 哇哦！突然就到我的休息时间了！谁能料到，这场我今晚绝对准备好要进行的对话，会以如此不合时宜的停火告终呢？！

lines.en: scene black
Noriko flips the open sign around and locks the door before leading the two of us through a small store room and into an alleyway.
lines.zh: Noriko 把「营业中」的牌子翻过来，锁上门，然后领着我们俩穿过一间小储藏室，走进一条小巷。

lines.en: It’s the exact sort of alley you’d expect to see in the worse half of town, filled with trash bags, broken bottles, and rats (Both dead and alive).
lines.zh: 这是一条你在城里较差的那半边会预期看到的那种小巷，堆满了垃圾袋、碎瓶子和老鼠（死的活的都有）。

lines.en: And while I’d like to say that I’m surprised Noriko is okay with hanging out around stuff like that...
lines.zh: 虽然我很想说，我对 Noriko 能在这种环境里若无其事地待着感到惊讶……

lines.en: I’m really not.
lines.zh: 但我真的一点也不惊讶。

lines.en: In fact, I’m {i}not{/i} surprised to say that she doesn’t seem fazed by them at all.
lines.zh: 事实上，她似乎完全没有被这些东西影响，这一点我一点都{i}不{/i}意外。

lines.en: And as she steps over the carcass of an animal that was once filled with life, I’m reminded once again of how truly unique and...overwhelmingly strange she is.
lines.zh: 当她跨过一具曾经充满生机的动物尸体时，我再次被提醒：她是多么独一无二，又是……多么异乎寻常地古怪。

lines.en: scene thatonefmkscene18
: Oh, sweet! We’re just in time for Nee-chan’s interview!
lines.zh: : 哦，太棒了！我们正好赶上姐姐的采访！

lines.en: : Interview?

lines.en: : She’s appearing on some variety show tonight to promote her next album.
lines.zh: : 她今晚要上一档综艺节目，宣传她的新专辑。

lines.en: : It’s really cool that she still does stuff like this even though it’s gotten to the point where just...slapping her name on something will guarantee it sells out in minutes.
lines.zh: : 明明现在只要……把她的名字往什么东西上一贴就能保证几分钟内售罄，她却还在做这种事，真的挺酷的。

lines.en: : Noriko, I’ve said this before and I’ll say it again now.
lines.zh: : Noriko，我之前说过，现在再说一遍。

lines.en: : I want your sister to do things to me.
lines.zh: : 我想让你姐姐对我做点什么。

lines.en: : She’s so pretty, isn’t she?
lines.zh: : 她好漂亮啊，是不是？

lines.en: : You seem weirdly okay with Kirin wanting to have sex with your sister.
lines.zh: : 你对 Kirin 想和你姐姐上床这事，接受得有点诡异啊。

lines.zh: : 嗯，我对她想和我爱的那个男人上床也接受得挺诡异的，而那显然更难以接受。

lines.en: : Have you really fucked this girl, Sensei?

: {i}Actually{/i}, Kirin. No. No, I have not.

lines.en: scene thatonefmkscene22
: Hello and welcome back! If you’re just tuning in now, {i}boy{/i} do we have a surprise for you.
lines.zh: : 大家好，欢迎回来！如果你现在才转过来，那我们有{i}大大的{/i}惊喜等着你。

lines.en: : Joining us today is the one...the only...Niki Nakayama, here to promote her new album, “Watermelon Fantasy!”
lines.zh: : 今天来到我们节目的是那位……独一无二的……Niki Nakayama，她来宣传她的新专辑《Watermelon Fantasy》！

lines.en: : Hihi! Thank you all so much for inviting me back! It’s been a while since I’ve done anything like this...so I’m really, {i}really{/i} nervous...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿！{i}非常{/i}感谢大家再次邀请我！我已经很久没做过这种事了……所以我真的、真的很紧张……

lines.en: : If any of you are watching at home, I hope you’re cheering me on! It might be hard, but I’ll do my best! Teehee~
lines.zh: : 如果你们有谁正在家里看电视，希望你们为我加油！可能会有点难，但我会尽全力的！嘻嘻~

lines.en: : She sounds completely different on television.

lines.en: : That’s just her idol voice. She switches back and forth so easily at this point that it’s kind of absurd.
lines.zh: : 那只是她的偶像嗓音。她切换得如此轻松，到现在已经有点离谱了。

lines.en: : So, Niki...Can you tell us a little more about this new album? There’s been a lot of buzz lately about some of the singles being a little more...{i}serious{/i} than what your fans are used to.
lines.zh: : 那么，Niki……能再跟我们多聊聊这张新专辑吗？最近有很多传闻说其中几首单曲比粉丝们习惯的要……{i}严肃{/i}一些。

lines.en: : Hmmm...I don’t think any of the songs are any more or less serious than the rest of my music!
lines.zh: : 嗯……我觉得这些歌都没有比我其他的音乐更严肃或者更不严肃！

lines.en: : I’m still the same Niki I’ve always been...and I’m putting just as much heart into my music as I have in the past.
lines.zh: : 我还是那个一直以来的 Niki……我在音乐里倾注的心血和过去一样多。

lines.en: : I’m glad you brought that up! Because it seems like “the past” has been a theme in your music since your debut- but no one really knows anything {i}about{/i} that past.
lines.zh: : 很高兴你提到这个！因为「过去」似乎从你出道起就是你音乐里的一个主题——但{i}关于{/i}那个过去，没人真正知道什么。

lines.en: : Is there a question there, or...?
lines.zh: : 这算是个问题吗，还是……？

lines.en: : I was just hoping you’d be able to tell us more about your origins. What was the “old” Niki like? And this...man you’re always talking about in your songs-
lines.zh: : 我只是希望你能多讲讲你的出身。以前的 Niki 是什么样的？还有这个……你在歌里总提到的那个男人——

lines.en: : Completely made up and not real at all. Next question, please.
lines.zh: : 完全是虚构的，根本不存在。下一个问题，谢谢。

lines.en: : O-Oh! Okay then! For my next question, I’d-
lines.zh: : 哦——哦！那好吧！我的下一个问题是——

lines.en: : Oh no! I’m so, so sorry! But I just remembered I have something {i}super{/i} important I have to do back in the studio!
lines.zh: : 哎呀不好！我真的、非常抱歉！但我刚想起来我得回录音棚处理一件{i}超级{/i}重要的事！

lines.en: : If you could just answer this last-
lines.zh: : 你能不能只回答最后这——

lines.en: : Anyway! Thanks for listening, everyone! Make sure to buy Watermelon Fantasy!
lines.zh: : 总之！谢谢大家收听，各位！一定要去买《Watermelon Fantasy》哦！

lines.en: : .................Aaaand, I suppose we’ll be right back after these messages from our sponsors!
lines.zh: .................那——么，我想我们会在赞助商的广告之后马上回来！

lines.en: scene thatonefmkscene23
: Oh, Nee-chan...
lines.zh: : 哦，姐姐……

lines.en: : She gets a little nippy when people ask about stuff from the past.
lines.zh: : 别人一问起过去的事，她就会有点炸毛。

lines.en: : But, in her defense, one of the stipulations in her contract for appearances like this is avoiding topics that could cause her to talk about it.
lines.zh: : 不过替她说句公道话，她这类出演活动的合同里就有一条规定：要避开可能让她谈起这些的话题。

lines.zh: 当你不仅把自己、还把身边所有人都当成垃圾一样对待时，就别指望能一路顺风顺水、永远听不到伤人的话。

lines.en: It’s her own fault that I chose the way I did. And it’s her own fault that I even {i}had{/i} to choose in the first place.
lines.zh: 我那么选是她自己的错。而我从一开始就{i}被迫{/i}要做选择，也是她自己的错。

lines.en: : We should probably...go back inside now...
lines.zh: : 我们大概该……回店里去了……

lines.en: : ...Yeah.

$ kirinspecial25skip = True

{i}Noriko’s affection has increased to [noriko_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Noriko 的好感度提升到了 [noriko_love]!{/i}

lines.en: $ kirinmarry = True
$ norikokill = True
: I’d fuck Chika, marry you, and kill Noriko.
lines.zh: : 我会睡 Chika，娶你，然后杀掉 Noriko。

lines.en: scene thatonefmkscene44
: You’d...
lines.zh: : 你会……

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Are you fucking kidding me?! What kind of ass backwards choice is that?!
lines.zh: : 你他妈在开玩笑吧？！这算什么倒行逆施的选择？！

lines.en: : What’s wrong? You asked me to answer and-
lines.zh: : 怎么了？是你让我回答的，而且——

lines.en: : You’re just messing with me, right?...
lines.zh: : 你只是在耍我，对吧？……

lines.en: : You’d never...
lines.zh: : 你才不会……

lines.en: : M-Me too! Why am I the one getting fucking married all of a sudden?! I never asked for this!
lines.zh: : 我——我也是！怎么突然就他妈变成我要结婚了？！我可从没要求过！

lines.en: : Kirin, you’re toxic and...a horrible person. But so am I, so I think it might actually wind up working out.
lines.zh: : Kirin，你很毒……而且是个糟糕的人。但我也一样，所以我觉得搞不好还真挺合适的。

lines.en: : It absolutely would not! That would never ever ever ever ever work out! Ever ever ever ever!
lines.zh: : 绝对不可能！这绝对、绝对、绝对、绝对、绝对不会有好结果的！永远永远永远永远不会！

lines.en: scene thatonefmkscene45
: N-Noriko! Come on! It’s only a game!
lines.zh: : N——Noriko！别这样！这只是个游戏而已！

lines.en: : Sensei just chose the most ridiculous answer on purpose to fuck with us! There’s no way he’d ever kill you! Just like there’s no way he’d ever marry {i}me{/i}!
lines.zh: : Sensei 只是故意选了最离谱的答案来耍我们！他绝对不可能杀你！就像他绝对不可能娶{i}我{/i}一样！

lines.en: : Did you...bring a handkerchief with you by any chance?
lines.zh: : 你……身上有没有带手帕？

lines.en: scene thatonefmkscene46
: Look what you fucking did! You made Noriko cry! And you made {i}me{/i} throw up in my mouth!
lines.zh: : 看看你他妈干了什么好事！你把 Noriko 弄哭了！还把{i}我{/i}都恶心吐了！

lines.en: : Is marrying me really such a horrible future?
lines.zh: : 嫁给我真的是那么可怕的未来吗？

lines.en: : That’s not the point!
lines.zh: : 重点不是这个！

lines.en: : The point is you’re supposed to {i}not{/i} kill Noriko! And {i}not{/i} marry me! Those are the worst things you could pick!
lines.zh: : 重点是你应该{i}别{/i}杀 Noriko！也{i}别{/i}娶我！那是最烂的两个选项！

lines.en: : Hey, you’re the one who asked me to choose. I’m just doing what I was told.
lines.zh: : 嘿，是你让我选的。我只是照你说的做而已。

lines.en: : I’m...going to go back inside now...
lines.zh: : 我……要回店里去了……

lines.en: scene black
: Noriko, wait!
lines.zh: : Noriko，等等！

lines.en: : Actually, on second thought, I don’t really feel good. I’m just gonna head home...
lines.zh: : 不过再想想，我确实不太舒服。我还是直接回家吧……

lines.en: : Goodnight, you two.
lines.zh: : 晚安，你们俩。

lines.en: : Noriko! Hold up!
lines.zh: : Noriko！等一下！
